title: BLS Employment Projections: National Employment Matrix, Veterinarians (SOC 29-1131), 2025 and projected 2035

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the fetched document.

publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Projections program
source_type: Government statistical table (occupation-by-industry employment matrix with projections)
reliability: Government statistical page; BLS is a neutral statistical agency, but figures are model-based projections. Release date is not shown on the page text read.
findings: Total veterinarian employment is 91.1 thousand in 2025, projected 99.6 thousand in 2035 (+8.6 thousand, +9.4%).
Self-employed veterinarians are 6.6 thousand (7.2% of the occupation) in 2025; wage and salary employment is 84.5 thousand (92.8%).
Veterinary services (NAICS 541940) employs 75.5 thousand veterinarians in 2025 (82.9% of the occupation), projected 83.0 thousand in 2035.
limitations: Self-employment status is not the same as owning an independent practice: owners who incorporate may be counted as wage and salary workers, so independent ownership share cannot be derived.
Counts and projections only; no data on administrative time or vacancies.
Release date and methodology were not read.
